title: Microsoft Teams: intelligent call recap for call queue calls in the Queues app on mobile
summary: The briefing matches Microsoft's roadmap and tenant notice, including the planned rollout and existing recording-access restrictions. The recording controls and product licensing requirements are documented, and the briefing appropriately distinguishes them from unpublished details specific to call queue recap.
